A->S.rationale: Answering information needs drives Google Search acquisition, including fresh information on recall cycles.

A->M.label: reported
A->M.rationale: Generated answers and their sources are stored in RSAMs.

record.label: stated
record.rationale: RSAMs retain assistant responses for subsequent recall.
record.quote: the response, the source of the response

outcome.label: stated
outcome.rationale: Dismissal persists as permanent exclusion of the rejected memory.
outcome.quote: permanent dismissal of unwanted (e.g., mismatched) memories

attribution.label: stated
attribution.rationale: Dismissal identifies the displayed memory and prevents its recurrence.

revision.label: not_stated
revision.rationale: Content refreshes and user-directed removal/settings do not establish service-authored mechanism revision.

later_use.label: not_stated
later_use.rationale: Repeated recalls are reported; execution under a revised mechanism is not.

notes: Text-only assessment. Outcome retention is inferred from permanent removal, not a separate feedback log.
